instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep one of a notification setting's options as this person's choice", and give it setting; choice.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:choose-my-notification-choice and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: setting is the setting's name and choice one option id from tool:my-notification-choice.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: notification-setting (records:read); notification-choice (records:read, records:write).
